_doc: Approved 2026-11-06. How the 15 pack units enter the game's three factions. units/data/unit_specs.json stays the pack's unchanged source; integration reads this file for faction, slot, display name and retunes. Rule: the game's existing names win every clash.

H.palette: olive drab and gunmetal with red stripes (the pack's oxide red becomes the stripe accent)

T.palette: matte white carbon with cyan status lights (already close to the pack)

A.palette: black glass, brushed titanium, magenta and teal neon (full re-skin from navy, light grey and amber)

retune.weapons: deck gun on the existing turret; CIWS anti-air and stern depth charges fire from sockets on the existing hull (effects only, no new geometry); values follow cmp_corvette, converted to metric at integration
retune.replaces: the pack's single naval assault gun (110 dmg / 2.5 s, 50 m)

units.restyle: android: graphite synthetic body, exposed joint actuators, ribbed neck, faceless head with a cyan visor slit (applied to the LOD0 model before the LODs were built)

units.slot: EMP infantry-class (new; lat_nullproj stays the EMP vehicle)
units.rename: clashes with Helix's Disruptor (hlx_disruptor); 'Nullifier' is a placeholder in the Lattice's Null Field / Null Projector family

units.note: flies, where the Wasp Skimmer hovers

units.rename: clashes with Helix's Specter (hlx_specter); takes the name of the slot it fills

units.dropped: Helix has no rocket infantry by design; the model stays in the pack and the sandbox

units.rename: clashes with the Lattice's Lancer (lat_lancer); takes the name of the slot it fills

units.note: fills the strike-bomber slot; no stealth
not in the pack: Helix's land anti-air vehicle (Helix keeps no rocket infantry); spec added to units/sandbox/data/unit_specs.json, model built separately
